newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Aetna cut by Smith Barney.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Aetna cut by Smith Barney.

text.p: Smith Barney cut its rating on Aetna Inc to outperform from buy, citing disappointment with the company's second quarter earnings, market sources said.
The analyst was not available for comment.
Sources said analyst Geoffrey Harris cited a sequential decline in operating earnings for Aetna's health risk business and an increase in the health risk medical loss ratio.
Trading in Aetna shares was delayed at the opening. The shares were indicated at 98-102. Aetna closed Monday at 117.

Aetna, reporting second quarter results, said medical costs were higher than prior-year periods as higher inpatient, physician and pharmacy costs were only partially slowed by recontracting and intensified patient management efforts.
The sources said Harris also cited a reserve "add back" of $31 million, which accounted for about $0.12 of earnings per share for the quarter.
Aetna reported second quarter operating earnings of $1.27 a share.
The First Call consensus estimate was $1.27 a share.
All other lines of business reported in line with Smith Barney's expectations, sources said.
